objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other controlled documents in the system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level (1-4) indicating strategic to operational scope.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: User-defined title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date (Valid From + validity period).

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration before validity review is required (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period documents are retained after invalidation (default 10 years).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Applicable scope or areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies to which the document applies.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Office format of the editable source file (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document released together with the main document, subject to its own versioning and the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status mirroring the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Non-controlled supplementary information added to a document, not subject to the release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional info is directly published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal suggestion to amend an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Planned, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request triggered before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated/archived document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who participates in document processes in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Business Admin).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign collective read or change authorizations and distribution.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Configured list of user groups and persons to be notified or required to acknowledge upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance guiding a document or request through defined approval steps.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Translation Release, Acknowledgement).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature recorded when a workflow participant completes a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step associated with the signature (Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Company organizational entity to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Business process entity that documents can be linked to for process-specific filing.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Organizational client in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template_used
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness within the review workflow step.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication in the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when content, attributes or attachments change.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Non-controlled additional information is attached to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Non-critical additional information is removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before document expiry.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) processes the validity extension request via workflow.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow (releaser-only or 3-step process).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared invalid; its status changes to Out of Force and archiving begins.

evts.name: revoke_authorizations
evts.description: All authorizations except the archive group are removed from the document upon invalidation.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is restored with a new version, reinstating metadata, authorizations and attachments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to or removed from the distribution list of a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is reviewed and released through a dedicated approval workflow.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive duration expires, the document is permanently deleted from the system.

A Request for Override is linked to the Document to be invalidated.
A Request for Reactivation references the archived Document to be restored.
Electronic Signatures are recorded per released version of a Document.
